qs.q: When calculating demographic indicators such as the Crude Birth Rate (CBR) or Infant Mortality Rate, what standard multiplier is applied in the formulas provided?
qs.e: The formulas for demographic indicators like CBR, CDR, Under-5 Mortality Rate, MMR, and Infant Mortality Rate in the notes all multiply the calculated fraction by 100,000.
